findings.impact: Directional reward bias propagates into relative hit-rate weights, study conviction and governor percentile inputs. Prior isolated fix commit must not be assumed loaded here.
findings.action: Choose neutral 0.5 grading in a separately reviewed change; prove equal LONG/SHORT flat grades and replay without other parameter changes.

findings.claim: V3 research controller is not the instantiated MPC; default orchestrator explicitly creates SimplePIDModelPredictiveControlBox.
findings.impact: Tester contracts and test receipts do not establish live/default deployment of a V3 PID trader.
findings.action: Maintain separate implementation/import/authority columns; integrate only with explicit mode and actuator contract.

findings.claim: PA signed signal adds unsigned volatility and volume terms to signed momentum/VWAP; sign reversal does not negate the full formula.
findings.impact: Magnitude confidence and sign symmetry are different properties. Generated symmetric PA source is not what the frozen orchestrator imports.
findings.action: Treat symmetric generated module as experiment-only until import/hash evidence; mirror-transform fixtures must cover all components.

findings.claim: ID applies synthetic confidence RR before MPC computes actual price geometry and independent Gate12 safety checks.
findings.impact: Multiple entry hurdles can remove most candidates despite a valid ATR stop/target; PA-only patch does not neutralize this synthetic RR.
findings.action: Record sequential reason accounting by side and describe interventions exactly; do not equate RR admission with physical target/stop RR.

findings.claim: Configured pid_derivative_smoothing is only traced by active SimplePID MPC, not applied.
findings.impact: Parameter-consumption receipts can overstate functional use. Single-step D may respond to discrete confidence/rank jumps.
findings.action: Mark trace-only parameter; add actual derivative filter only through isolated controller specification and tests.

findings.claim: Continuous exit PID ratchets and saturation are advisory when governor_authority is full.
findings.impact: A passing exit PID test cannot establish actual discretionary exit ownership. Governor decision and hard lifecycle/protection paths remain decisive.
findings.action: Test mode-specific actuator matrix and trace winning exit authority for each actual trade.

findings.claim: Alternative grid exit prototype open_position supplies initial_stop_price to a dataclass lacking that field.
findings.impact: Calling this prototype opening path raises TypeError. It is not default imported, so no current-default impact is inferred.
findings.action: Fix dataclass constructor consistency before any integration and test opening both sides.

findings.claim: Grid prototype compares NIFTY to itself and its documented tightening multiplier increases stop distance.
findings.impact: Self-comparison cannot measure stock/grid synchronization; 1.5 widens candidate ATR stop distance while comments say tighten. Existing ratchet does not loosen stored stop but proposed tightening is weaker.
findings.action: Keep prototype disconnected; use actual stock series and settle multiplier sign/units with mirrored examples.

findings.claim: Curve entry quality substitutes 1.0 for zero amplitude/frequency errors using Python truthiness.
findings.impact: Perfect amplitude/frequency matching gives zero quality and a positive PID derate even when synchronized is true; shadow timing telemetry contradicts range flag.
findings.action: Use explicit None handling; test exact equality and near-zero errors.

findings.claim: Both-stop-and-target shadow outcome label says stop precedence but execution falls through to close.
findings.impact: Shadow costs/net feedback may be optimistic or inconsistent for ambiguous bars; does not modify production broker.
findings.action: Apply conservative stop fill or exclude ambiguous outcome consistently; cover gap and both-hit side cases.

findings.claim: FinalExecutionController uses any absolute studies clamp as sustained low-confidence signal.
findings.impact: Telemetry recommendation can claim sustained deterioration without sign or consecutive-bar evidence; actual saturation helper has a different contract.
findings.action: Use the actual positive saturation count/reason in the final recommendation and distinguish single clamp versus persistence.

findings.claim: Entry PID changes market reference with the same sign for BUY and SELL rather than selecting a later entry bar.
findings.impact: A lower reference price helps BUY and harms SELL relative to market, and timing_multiplier is a size derate, not order waiting. Paper adjustment is not a broker fill guarantee.
findings.action: Specify entry actuator units and side semantics; test price realism separately from entry confidence sizing.

findings.claim: Frozen target fit does not enforce its provided seed timestamp cutoff inside the method.
findings.impact: Stored seed_start/end labels alone do not prove causal training selection. Caller must supply pre-cutoff completed trades.
findings.action: Audit caller filtering and hash seed input; add explicit cutoff validation before later promotion.

findings.claim: Intraday PnL shadow stops accepting outcomes after a halt/target lock and has no day reset method.
findings.impact: Outstanding research trade outcomes after lock can leave net PnL accounting stale; reusing instance across sessions preserves prior state.
findings.action: Separate accounting from admission latch and define explicit session reset before any production use.
